name: prose-author
description: Blank-page drafting and passage rewriting in a specific person's measured voice. Renders a cited profile from their corpus, drafts without corpus access, and reports the checks and limits honestly.

interface.shortDescription: Drafts new prose or rewrites a passage from your measured voice profile.
interface.longDescription: Adds a blank-page path to the existing passage rewriter. voice-profile-render reads a single-author corpus and emits cited semantic findings that deterministic tools assemble into voice-profile/2. voice-draft then receives only the writing request and rendered profile, not the corpus, exemplars, session history, or AI-tell catalog. Deterministic conformance and a separate factual-basis audit make deviations and unsupported claims visible; they do not guarantee factual accuracy or resemblance. Independent prose-review and prose-tell-scan checks are required before describing a result as gated. On Codex and other advisory harnesses, run the stages in fresh contexts because prompt metadata alone cannot enforce corpus isolation.
defaultPrompt: This paragraph isn't working - rewrite it the way I write
Draft this section from my notes, in my voice
Write a new essay from this outline using my voice profile
Draft a reply for this reader and purpose in my voice
